These are the restaurants open on Easter Sunday. Goodbye, cooking and cleanup! Easter Sunday falls on April 5 this year, and it will be here before you know it. There’s a lot that goes into planning an Easter celebration, like organizing Easter egg hunts, getting Easter baskets for the whole family and coordinating other fun Easter traditions with your loved ones. It’s a lot to juggle, so if you want to get something off your plate, consider grabbing food at one of these restaurants open on Easter. These restaurants have options that will make your Easter a bit easier, whether you’re looking for a full Easter meal or a quick to-go snack (so there’s no need to find a store open on Easter to cook your own meal). No cleanup—just delicious food with those you love most. Quick note: While these restaurants have announced that they will be open on Easter Sunday, it’s best to call ahead to confirm hours and make reservations where you can. So read on for some of the best restaurants open on Easter and enjoy! Get Reader’s Digest’s Read Up newsletter for more holiday tips, fun facts, humor, cleaning, travel and tech all week long. What restaurants are open on Easter Sunday 2026? Applebee’s: If you feel like “eatin’ good in the neighborhood” on Easter, you’re in luck! Applebee’s is open during regular hours on Easter Sunday. However, these restaurants are independently owned, so it’s best to call your local Applebee’s to confirm its hours. Bahama Breeze: This Caribbean-inspired eatery and grill is one of the many restaurants open on Easter. So find one near you and get ready to enjoy mouth-watering tropical food and drinks. Benihana: This sushi and Japanese steakhouse is open on Easter—perfect for satisfying any shrimp or sashimi cravings. Bob Evans: Bob Evans is open for Easter this year. You can dine in, take out or order delivery for Easter brunch or dinner. Bonefish Grill: If you’re in the mood for seafood on Easter, make a reservation at Bonefish Grill. Or you can opt for takeout and enjoy the food at home. Boston Market: Don’t feel like cooking Easter dinner? Boston Market has you covered. Order a delicious heat-and-serve meal for the whole family, and pick it up after your family’s Easter egg hunt wraps up. Buffalo Wild Wings: Enjoy drums and flats at this restaurant open on Easter. The wing chain will be open for both dine-in and takeout options. UCG/Getty Images Burger King: Burger King is typically open during regular hours on Easter. However, since most locations are privately owned, some may have reduced hours or be closed. If you’re craving a Whopper on Easter Sunday, call your local restaurant to ask if they’re open. Carrabba’s Italian Grill: All locations are open on Easter. Enjoy dinner in, or take your meal from Carrabba’s to go. Cheddar’s Scratch Kitchen: Enjoy scratch-made food—from lemon pepper chicken to baby back ribs—at Cheddar’s on Easter Sunday. Chili’s: You can walk through Chili’s doors and hear “Welcome to Chili’s!” on Easter Sunday, as locations are open for regular hours. Cracker Barrel: Most Cracker Barrel locations will be open, so you can stop in for a meal or pick it up to take home. SOPA Images/Getty Images Dairy Queen: If you’re hankering for some ice cream on Easter, good news—Dairy Queen locations are open on Easter. Denny’s: Denny’s will be open for normal hours on Easter Sunday. Great news for all the Easter brunchers out there! Domino’s: Craving pizza on Easter? Order delivery from Domino’s—the pizza chain is typically open during regular hours on Easter. Some local stores may have reduced hours, though, so it’s best to call ahead to double check. Dunkin’: Whether you’re traveling to see family on the big day or just need a caffeine boost before getting the cooking underway, you can grab a coffee at Dunkin’ on Easter. Most locations will be open for regular hours. Michael M. Santiago/Getty Images Famous Dave’s: Are you a BBQ lover? If so, head on over to Famous Dave’s to feast on some award-winning ribs. Five Guys: Five Guys locations are expected to be open for regular hours on Easter. Fleming’s Steakhouse: Celebrate Easter with Fleming’s Steakhouse’s three-course Easter Weekend Brunch Menu (available until 3 p.m.). It includes sliced tenderloin and French onion frittata. Yum! Fogo de Chão: Steak for Easter brunch? Yes, please! Luckily, Fogo de Chão is open on Easter, starting at 11 a.m. IHOP: Start Easter morning with flapjacks at IHOP. Most locations will be open for normal business hours on Easter, but call your local IHOP to check its hours. UCG/Getty Images Jimmy John’s: Those craving a sub on Easter can stop in at Jimmy John’s, as locations are expected to be open on Easter. KFC: KFC restaurants are typically open during regular hours on Easter Sunday, but some locations may have reduced hours. To be safe, call your local restaurant to confirm its holiday hours. Kona Grill: Here’s another restaurant open on Easter—and they always offer a festive menu for the holiday. LongHorn Steakhouse: LongHorn Steakhouse locations will be open on Easter, but call ahead to double check if hours will be reduced. McDonald’s: Yes, you can get chicken nuggets, fries and a Coke from McDonald’s on Easter Sunday. The chain is typically open during regular hours, but some locations may have reduced hours. Smith Collection/Gado/Getty Images Olive Garden: Not feeling ham for Easter dinner? Get pasta instead at Olive Garden. Dine in or order takeout for the whole family. Outback Steakhouse: Outback locations will be open on Easter this year. Steak enthusiasts, rejoice! P.F. Chang’s: P.F. Chang’s is open on Easter Sunday, and you can make a reservation or order takeout. Panera Bread: Typically, Panera Bread is open on Easter. Some locations may have reduced hours. Papa John’s: Papa John’s is usually open on Easter Sunday, but it’s best to call your local restaurant to double check. Red Lobster: Red Lobster is open on Easter, so you can indulge in a seafood dinner if you’d like. Yum! Red Robin: Typically, Red Robin locations are open on Easter, so if you’re in the mood for a burger on the big day, you’re in luck. UCG/Getty Images Romano’s Macaroni Grill: Craving pasta this Easter Sunday? Romano’s Macaroni Grill has got you covered with classic Italian flavors. Give them a ring beforehand to check their holiday hours. Ruby Tuesday: Ruby Tuesday locations will be open on Easter. Brunch awaits! Seasons 52: Order online or enjoy Easter brunch in this grill’s dining room. Entree options include wood-grilled shrimp and grits, and French toast. Sonic: Most Sonic locations are open on Easter Sunday. Hit the drive-thru and enjoy! Starbucks: While most locations will be open on Easter, some may be closed. Call your local Starbucks or find it on the Starbucks store locator to check the hours. STK Steakhouse: Delight in a mouthwatering steakhouse meal at this restaurant open on Easter. Every guest on Easter weekend will get an Easter egg—and may have the chance to see the Easter Bunny too! Robert Alexander/Getty Images Taco Bell: Live más on Easter! Taco Bell locations will be open on the holiday. Texas Roadhouse: If you’re craving those Texas Roadhouse rolls on Easter, we’ve got some good news for you. Texas Roadhouse locations will be open for dining in and takeout. The Cheesecake Factory: The Cheesecake Factory will be open on Easter, so you can make a reservation and dine in for brunch or dinner. Don’t forget to order dessert! Tim Hortons: Grab a coffee on Easter Sunday at Tim Hortons. Locations will be open for the holiday. Waffle House: Breakfast lovers, this one’s for you—Waffle House locations will be open for Easter. Wendy’s: Wendy’s locations are typically open on Easter, but hours at certain locations may vary. We recommend calling your local restaurant to confirm its hours.
